name: anvaka/map-of-github
line: A map of 690K GitHub projects. Frozen snapshot dated 2025-05-10, built from star events up to May 2025. Closeness means shared stargazers, not what a project does. Newer projects are missing.
licence: README states MIT, with a request to credit the project when its data is used; no LICENSE file
